Audit GUI displays AuditFinding fields only. Backend test serializes audit result and asserts it does not contain the known synthetic password github-pass.

Reviewed GUI slices 1-7. Fixed entry password normalization so add/edit password fields preserve non-empty leading/trailing whitespace instead of trimming secret values. Added Rust unit coverage for this behavior. Full GUI and workspace verification passed.

Split GUI frontend main.ts into shell, state, dom, render, clipboard, and errors modules. main.ts reduced from 845 lines to 365 lines and now focuses on event wiring/orchestration. Static shell innerHTML is isolated and no vault/entry/secret data is interpolated into it.

Replaced GUI Tauri Result<T, String> errors with lightweight structured GuiError { kind, message } at the Tauri boundary. Added validation_failed and unlock_failed coverage while leaving anahtar-app/core error design unchanged.

Made Vite dev frontend use --strictPort because Tauri devUrl is fixed to 127.0.0.1:1420. This prevents Vite from silently moving to 1421 and leaving the Tauri window pointed at the wrong URL when port 1420 is occupied.
